output.body: Take sum_to(n), which equals 1+2+...+n. Its base case is sum_to(0)=0, because there is nothing to add and no smaller problem to ask about. Its recursive case is sum_to(n) = n + sum_to(n-1), which shrinks toward that base case every time.
output.key_idea: A recursive function answers the simplest case directly and expresses every bigger case through a slightly smaller copy of the same problem.
